title: 4521-ESP-ANC-00-61-PS001V
summary:
- Contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
- Confidential and proprietary information restrictions apply.
- Vendor data submission instructions via Prolog Website.
- Documents must include specific vendor identification details.
- All documents should be in black and white PDF format.
- Documents must be submitted as single e-files in English, US-Customary units.
- Final drawings must be in .pdf and .dwg formats for project submission.
- Vendor must notify Abener Teyma of any changes to final drawings within 5 days.
- Bill of material must include OEM names, equipment part numbers, and ratings.
- Software files must be zipped and meet document requirements.
- Exceptions apply if vendor cannot provide documents in electronic form.
- Vendor data requirements include specific documents for piping, solar field header shop fabrication.
